root_cause: The supported repair workflow proved zero migration-list drift before PR #3766 merged, but the #3742 terminal contract also requires a production migration-ledger readback after protected merge. Supabase MCP readback was unavailable due connection timeouts and the trusted OIDC workflow did not yet have a non-mutating post-merge mode.
prevention: Keep the trusted OIDC workflow path as the sole database-transport authority.
When canonical PR #3766 is already merged, switch the workflow to readback mode automatically instead of attempting branch mutation.
Require zero migration-list drift, exact 568-entry ledger cardinality, and remote/local presence of all four repaired replay baselines.
Skip the branch lock/PR writeback step in readback mode so no provider or repository mutation is repeated.
Upload immutable post-merge readback evidence for terminal closure.

evaluation.expected: A trusted-main push after the readback-mode change obtains DB transport through GitHub OIDC, executes only Supabase migration list when parity is already zero, proves 568/568 parity and the four repaired versions, and uploads readback evidence without invoking migration repair or branch mutation.
